chunks: My saviour is God who has revealed this Book; and He protects those who are upright;
ai.seo_question: Who is the Wali (guardian) of the righteous according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is pivotal for establishing the concept of *Wilayah*, affirming God as the primary guardian who delegates authority to the righteous, particularly the Imams. It underscores the theological link between divine revelation and the spiritual protection of those who embody piety, serving as a foundation for the Imamate's role in guiding the community.
